run_robustness_eval_cli: run the corruption result analysis CLI tool on a result file for COCO or VOC datasets
get_coco_style_results: get COCO-style corruption benchmark results including AP and AR metrics from an evaluation file
get_voc_style_results: get Pascal VOC-style corruption benchmark results with AP50 metrics from an evaluation file
get_results: get corruption benchmark results for COCO, VOC, or Cityscapes datasets with configurable metrics and aggregation
get_distortions_from_file: get the list of distortion names from a corruption benchmark evaluation result file
